title: Situ Nan Returns
summary: Situ Nan, awake again and speaking through Wang Lin, drives off Zhu Quezi, who recognises him as the second Suzaku when he names the first Suzaku, Ye Wuyou. For Ye Wuyou's sake Situ Nan lends Zhu Quezi the Fourth Main Soul for three years to fight the Forsaken Immortal Clan, but takes two of his fingers as the price. Dun Tian, at peace, pours his memories into a memory flag for Wang Lin and wipes his own mind to join the Billion Soul Flag beside his master Yun Yimo. In the north of the Suzaku Continent, Situ Nan devours the Ancestor Spirit of a Reincarnation Tree, wiping out an Ascendant shaman the clan was about to hatch. With Wang Lin's help, he lures a young Ascendant-level Forsaken pursuer into the Jiuli Qi barrier of the Little Northern Extreme Fire region and seizes his Demon Child body. Situ Nan lets Wang Lin keep the Heaven Defying Bead and warns him about the Cultivation Planet Crystal, the Cultivation Alliance's tool for draining the life souls of a planet's people, which Situ Nan himself sealed long ago. Wang Lin swears that no one will control his fate and that he will take back Wan'er's life soul, which the crystal also holds.

cultivation: Yun Yimo, a former master of the Soul Refining Sect, is at late Soul Transformation (in memory). The Forsaken Immortal Fourth Ancestor is a nine-leaf shaman, who mocks Zhu Quezi's opponent as only early Ascendant. Situ Nan's new body has a Demon Child physique and Ascendant cultivation. Situ Nan notes that Wang Lin has reached Soul Transformation despite having an Extreme Realm.

changes: Checked against the official English and Chinese YouTube subtitles (ep96.en/zh.vtt) and the Indonesian fansub.

The barrier is 九黎之气 (Jiuli Qi), not 'ninefold dark energy'. The light is 极炎月之光. The crystal is 修星之晶 (Cultivation Planet Crystal), and the object linked to it is 修星之心. The body Situ Nan takes has 魔童肉身和问鼎修为. The final vow is 婉儿命魂我也会一并夺回.
